transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

I guess I’m here because I’ve taken on too much lately. Projects, workshops, fixing up the studio, calls with clients… more than I can really keep up with. Now the deadlines and the mortgage are starting to feel like they’re closing in.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I still care about my work. I’m just overwhelmed.
Have you been feeling down or hopeless, or have you had trouble sleeping or changes in your appetite lately?
I’m not sure I’d call it hopeless. Sleep and food… I haven’t really been paying close attention, honestly. Just feels like there’s a lot on my plate.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels lately, or have you been feeling more tired than usual?
More energy, I suppose. Not tired, exactly. I wake up with this… current in me, and then I’m moving things around in the studio, writing proposals, emailing people. Sitting still has been hard.
Have you had periods where you felt unusually upbeat, energized, or irritable — not just about the stress, but like your mood was really elevated?

Yes… I mean, most days I’ve felt kind of unusually lit up. Like everything in the studio and the garden was finally fitting together. But I’ve also been… sharper than usual, I guess. If someone questions what I’m doing, or asks about invoices, I can snap.
Can you describe how long these periods of feeling unusually energized or 'lit up' have been going on? Have they been happening every day for most of the day, or come and go?
It’s been… maybe three months. Around when I took on the mortgage for the cottage-studio. It’s not just a day here and there, no. It’s been pretty steady.
Has there been a time when your mood was so high or irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self, even apart from just being busy or stressed?

Yes. Most days I’ve felt… unusually buoyant, I guess. Like the studio and the garden were finally clicking into place. But I’ve also been more irritable than I’d like—if someone questioned my plans or brought up invoices, I could snap pretty sharply.
Has there been a distinct period when your mood was so high, irritable, or 'wired' that it was clearly different from your usual self—even when you weren’t just busy or stressed?

Yes… I think so. Most days I felt unusually buoyant, kind of lit up, like everything with the studio and garden was finally coming together. But I was also quicker to snap if anyone questioned my plans or brought up invoices.
Can you think of a specific time when your mood was so high or 'lit up' that it was noticeably different from your usual self, not just busy or stressed?

Yes… when the studio and the garden started feeling like they were finally coming together. Most days I felt sort of buoyant—lit up, I guess. More than my usual self. And if someone questioned the plans or asked about invoices, I’d snap more sharply than I normally would.
When you say you've felt unusually buoyant and energized most days, has that lasted for at least one full week without breaking, even if others noticed it was different from your usual self?
Yes… more than a week. It’s been going on, off and on but mostly there, for about three months—since I took on the mortgage for the cottage-studio.
